About Me

Hi, I am Alexander “AJ” Garcia — an Information/Data Science graduate of the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, with a minor in Data Science and an Information Trust Institute Certificate in Cybersecurity.

I work in Python and SQL to clean data, run exploratory and statistical analysis, test hypotheses, and turn the results into visualizations and conclusions people can actually use. Alongside that, I spent two years supporting university technology — troubleshooting wired and wireless networks, resolving software tickets, and maintaining computer labs, including UIUC’s XR Lab. That mix has given me a well-rounded perspective: technical depth paired with the customer-service instinct to explain a problem in plain language.

I am motivated by building secure, efficient technical environments and by collaborative problem solving.

Video Game Reviews and U.S. Sales Analysis — Oct 2024
